Hi all — quick technical summary ahead of Tue’s call and attached is a starter architecture diagram (redwood_private_architecture.pdf). Key points: 

1) Private control plane / VPC-hosted: 
   - Model serving runs in customer-managed VPC (we deploy infra into a customer account or peered VPC depending on cloud provider).
   - We support VPC peering, AWS PrivateLink, and VPC endpoints for control/metrics traffic — minimal public egress required if configured correctly.

2) Dedicated capacity: 
   - Dedicated GPU pools provisioned into your VPC (or through a managed account) with isolated tenant networking.
   - Autoscaling and burst policies are configurable; we surface metrics via customer-hosted endpoints.

3) On-prem / air-gapped: 
   - We offer an air-gapped appliance deployment. Constraints: automatic updates require a signed bundle exchange; monitoring and support use an offline transfer process or temporary allowed egress tunnel under explicit customer approval.
   - Maintenance windows and manual patching processes are documented; we provide signed artifacts and verification checksums.

4) KMS/HSM & keys: 
   - We integrate with customer KMS (AWS KMS / CloudHSM / customer HSM) for key wrapping. For air-gapped, keys remain in the customer HSM and we accept wrapped keys.

Network requirements (things we’ll need from FinServ ahead of the call): 
- CIDR ranges for all VPCs involved, egress/ingress port rules, NAT/EIP usage, and any proxy/inspection devices.
- Expected throughput and max token rate per second for sizing GPU pools.

I’ll bring the diagram and a short runbook to Tue’s call. If Alex wants any specific details included (e.g., encryption-at-rest for logs, audit log retention periods), let me know and I’ll add them.

Attachment: redwood_private_architecture.pdf

Hi Alex / team — thanks for sharing the questionnaire. A few security/compliance notes to help you complete the form and for the upcoming call: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is currently undergoing a SOC 2 Type II audit; the expected completion date is Q3 2026. We can provide our SOC 2 Type I and control descriptions now. There are no high-priority open findings that would block a new customer onboarding — our remediation backlog is captured and we can share an anonymized summary if useful.

- GDPR/HIPAA: We have a standard DPA for GDPR and a BAA template for HIPAA-covered deployments. For PHI workloads we require the Dedicated or Private deployment pattern and technical controls (customer-managed KMS, audit log retention settings).

- Vendor questionnaire: Attached is a short security evidence index (security_evidence_index.pdf) listing commonly requested artifacts (flow diagrams, encryption details, pen test reports (redacted), incident response summary). For anything that requires legal sign-off (BAA, DPA), please mark those items and we’ll route to legal.

- Air-gap notes: For fully air-gapped installs we require an initial secure bundle exchange and periodic signed update packages; support is provided via secured offline channels — this increases lead time vs. hosted deployments but is a supported option.

We’ll be ready to walk through detailed answers on Tue 2/22 10am PT. Marcus — I’ve drafted responses to the high-priority questionnaire items and will share them as a follow-up to this thread.
